प्रधानाचार्य द्वारा अभ्यास और जलवायु का अवलोकन करने के लिए संक्षिप्त, बार-बार, अनौपचारिक कक्षा दौरे
छात्रों और मार्चिंग बैंड का औपचारिक समारोहिक परेड जो व्यवस्थित रूप से स्कूल के गलियारों में चलता है

questions.question_english: What does the practice of 'Instructional Walkthroughs' involve?
options_english: The Principal spending an entire full working day continuously observing a single individual teacher in class
Brief, frequent, informal classroom visits by the Principal to observe practice and climate
A formal ceremonial parade of students and marching bands systematically moving through the school corridors
External inspecting officials systematically reviewing the non-academic financial registers and records of the school
questions.explanation_english: Instructional walkthroughs are brief, frequent, and informal classroom visits conducted by school administrators to observe ongoing teaching practices, curriculum execution, and learning climate. Lasting between three to ten minutes, these unannounced visits afford leaders a realistic overview of institutional instruction without disrupting classroom routines or causing evaluation anxiety.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। इंस्ट्रक्शनल वॉकथ्रू संक्षिप्त, बार-बार, और अनौपचारिक कक्षा दौरे हैं जो स्कूल प्रशासन द्वारा चलाए जाते हैं ताकि चल रहे शिक्षण अभ्यास, पाठ्यक्रम कार्यान्वयन, और सीखने की जलवायु का अवलोकन किया जा सके। ये अनियोजित दौरे तीन से दस मिनट के बीच होते हैं, जो नेताओं को संस्थागत शिक्षण का वास्तविक अवलोकन प्रदान करते हैं बिना कक्षा की दिनचर्या को बाधित किए या मूल्यांकन की चिंता उत्पन्न किए।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Brief, frequent, informal classroom visits by the Principal to observe practice and climate

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Instructional walkthroughs are brief, frequent, and informal classroom visits conducted by school administrators to observe ongoing teaching practices, curriculum execution, and learning climate.

एक संचयी भंडार जिसमें केवल
            कर्मचारी को जारी किए गए औपचारिक अनुशासनात्मक शो-कॉज मेमो शामिल हैं

questions.question_english: The 'Service Book' of a government school teacher is a vital personnel record that contains:
options_english: The detailed daily instructional lesson plans, pedagogical notes, and classroom teaching diary entries
The chronological record of employee career events, appointments, increments, and leave accounts
A cumulative repository containing only the formal disciplinary show-cause memos issued to the employee
The official summary of academic marks, board grades, and test scores secured by the teacher’s students
questions.explanation_english: The Service Book is an official permanent personnel record maintained for every government school employee. It records chronological career milestones, official appointment orders, promotions, pay fixations, annual financial increments, leave balances, and disciplinary history, serving as the definitive legal document for determining pension benefits and service entitlements.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। सेवा पुस्तक एक आधिकारिक स्थायी कर्मचारी रिकॉर्ड है जो प्रत्येक सरकारी स्कूल कर्मचारी के लिए बनाए रखा जाता है। यह कालानुक्रमिक करियर मील के पत्थरों, आधिकारिक नियुक्ति आदेशों, पदोन्नतियों, वेतन निर्धारण, वार्षिक वित्तीय वृद्धि, छुट्टी संतुलन और अनुशासनात्मक इतिहास को रिकॉर्ड करता है, जो पेंशन लाभ और सेवा अधिकारों के निर्धारण के लिए अंतिम कानूनी दस्तावेज के रूप में कार्य करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) The chronological record of employee career events, appointments, increments, and leave accounts
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Service Book is an official permanent personnel record maintained for every government school employee.

questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित रिकॉर्डिंग तकनीकों में से कौन सी तकनीक पर्यवेक्षक द्वारा पाठ के एक विशेष भाग के दौरान शिक्षक और छात्रों द्वारा कहे गए शब्दों को ठीक से लिखने में शामिल होती है?

मात्रात्मक आवृत्ति तालिका चार्ट
चयनात्मक शब्दशः प्रतिलिपि
गुणात्मक उपाख्यानात्मक सारांश रिकॉर्ड

questions.question_english: Which of the following recording techniques involves the supervisor documenting verbatim what is said by the teacher and students during a specific segment of the lesson?
options_english: Global performance rating scale
Quantitative frequency tally chart
Selective verbatim transcript
Qualitative anecdotal summary record
questions.explanation_english: A selective verbatim transcript is a precise observational recording technique where the supervisor writes down exact spoken words, phrases, or question types exchanged between teachers and students. This method provides highly objective, concrete linguistic data, enabling educators during post-observation conferences to analyze communication patterns, questioning depth, and classroom dialogue accurately.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। चयनात्मक शब्दशः प्रतिलिपि एक सटीक अवलोकन रिकॉर्डिंग तकनीक है जहाँ पर्यवेक्षक शिक्षक और छात्रों के बीच आदान-प्रदान किए गए सटीक बोले गए शब्दों, वाक्यांशों या प्रश्न प्रकारों को लिखता है। यह विधि अत्यधिक वस्तुनिष्ठ, ठोस भाषाई डेटा प्रदान करती है, जिससे शिक्षकों को पोस्ट-अवलोकन सम्मेलनों के दौरान संचार पैटर्न, प्रश्न पूछने की गहराई और कक्षा संवाद का सटीक विश्लेषण करने में सक्षम बनाती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Selective verbatim transcript
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: A selective verbatim transcript is a precise observational recording technique.

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): A Principal can delegate authority to the Vice-Principal or Head of Department to sanction casual leave for teachers.
Reason (R): Accountability can be completely delegated along with authority to ensure administrative efficiency.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Administrators can delegate authority to lower management positions, such as department heads or vice-principals, to handle operational tasks like leave approvals. However, administrative principles dictate that accountability can never be fully delegated. The head of the institution remains ultimately answerable to higher governing authorities for all actions and decisions made under their delegated authority.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। प्रशासक विभाग के प्रमुखों या उप-प्रधानों जैसे निम्न प्रबंधन पदों को कार्यात्मक कार्यों को संभालने के लिए अधिकार सौंप सकते हैं, जैसे कि अवकाश अनुमोदन। हालाँकि, प्रशासनिक सिद्धांत यह निर्धारित करते हैं कि जवाबदेही को कभी भी पूरी तरह से सौंपा नहीं जा सकता। संस्थान का प्रमुख सभी कार्यों और निर्णयों के लिए अंततः उच्च शासी प्राधिकरणों के प्रति उत्तरदायी रहता है जो उनके सौंपे गए अधिकार के तहत किए जाते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) A is true but R is false

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Administrators can delegate authority to lower management positions, such as department heads or vice-principals, to handle operational tasks like leave approvals.

questions.question_english: What is the primary purpose of classroom observation in school supervision?
options_english: To gather evidence for punitive administrative action against teachers
To rank teachers for performance-based financial bonuses
To improve instructional quality and enhance student learning outcomes
To fulfill the mandatory compliance quotas set by the Directorate
questions.explanation_english: The fundamental purpose of classroom observation in educational supervision is to enhance instructional quality and maximize student learning outcomes. Through systematic observation, supervisors gather objective pedagogical data, identify teaching strengths, discover areas requiring refinement, and engage in constructive dialogue with educators to support continuous professional development and effective classroom practices.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। कक्षा अवलोकन का मूल उद्देश्य शैक्षणिक गुणवत्ता में सुधार करना और छात्र सीखने के परिणामों को अधिकतम करना है। व्यवस्थित अवलोकन के माध्यम से, पर्यवेक्षक वस्तुनिष्ठ शैक्षणिक डेटा इकट्ठा करते हैं, शिक्षण की ताकतों की पहचान करते हैं, सुधार की आवश्यकता वाले क्षेत्रों को खोजते हैं, और निरंतर पेशेवर विकास और प्रभावी कक्षा प्रथाओं का समर्थन करने के लिए शिक्षकों के साथ रचनात्मक संवाद में संलग्न होते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) To improve instructional quality and enhance student learning outcomes

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The fundamental purpose of classroom observation in educational supervision is to enhance instructional quality and maximize student learning outcomes.

questions.question_english: In the context of school management, the term 'Span of Control' refers to:
options_english: The geographical and demographic catchment area from which a school actively draws its students
The total continuous duration for which a Principal holds administrative office in a given school
The total institutional budget allocated for routine supervisory activities across an academic year
The maximum number of subordinate staff that a single administrator can effectively supervise
questions.explanation_english: The span of control in educational administration defines the maximum number of subordinate staff members that a single leader or supervisor can efficiently direct and monitor. An optimal span ensures effective oversight, timely feedback, and smooth communication without overburdening the administrator or creating excessive administrative delays in decision-making and operational supervisory workflows.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। नियंत्रण का विस्तार शैक्षणिक प्रशासन में उस अधिकतम संख्या को परिभाषित करता है जिसे एक एकल नेता या पर्यवेक्षक प्रभावी रूप से निर्देशित और निगरानी कर सकता है। एक आदर्श नियंत्रण का विस्तार प्रभावी पर्यवेक्षण, समय पर फीडबैक और सुचारू संचार सुनिश्चित करता है, बिना प्रशासक पर अधिक बोझ डाले या निर्णय लेने और परिचालन पर्यवेक्षण कार्यप्रवाह में अत्यधिक प्रशासनिक देरी उत्पन्न किए।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) The maximum number of subordinate staff that a single administrator can effectively supervise

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Span of control in educational administration defines the maximum number of subordinate staff members that a single leader or supervisor can efficiently direct and monitor.

सभी संस्थागत वित्तीय शक्तियों को शीर्ष प्रबंधन के हाथों में केंद्रीकृत करना

questions.question_english: The principle of 'Esprit de Corps' in educational management emphasizes:
options_english: Promoting team spirit, harmony, and unity among the school staff
Enforcing strict administrative disciplinary action for any acts of staff insubordination
The systematic division of administrative labor into highly specialized organizational tasks
Centralizing all institutional financial powers exclusively in the hands of top management
questions.explanation_english: Esprit de Corps is a fundamental administrative principle formulated by Henri Fayol that emphasizes cultivating team spirit, mutual trust, and harmony among organizational staff. In educational management, fostering strong collegial unity and shared identity encourages staff collaboration, boosts institutional morale, and minimizes interpersonal friction across departments.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। एस्प्रिट डे कॉर्प्स एक मौलिक प्रशासनिक सिद्धांत है जिसे हेनरी फेयोल ने तैयार किया है, जो संगठनात्मक कर्मचारियों के बीच टीम भावना, आपसी विश्वास और सामंजस्य को बढ़ावा देने पर जोर देता है। शैक्षिक प्रबंधन में, मजबूत सहयोगी एकता और साझा पहचान को बढ़ावा देना कर्मचारियों के सहयोग को प्रोत्साहित करता है, संस्थागत मनोबल को बढ़ाता है, और विभागों के बीच अंतरव्यक्तिगत तनाव को कम करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Promoting team spirit, harmony, and unity

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Esprit de Corps is a fundamental administrative principle formulated by Henri Fayol that emphasizes cultivating team spirit, mutual trust, and harmony among organizational staff.

questions.question_english: In the development of observation checklists or rubrics, what does 'Inter-rater reliability' refer to?
options_english: The statistical correlation observed between a teacher’s annual attendance record and their observation score
The predictive ability of the evaluation rubric to determine overall student performance in final board exams
The total frequency and regularity with which formal instructional observations are conducted within an academic term
The consistency with which the rubric measures the same teaching behavior across different supervisors
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is 'The consistency with which the rubric measures the same teaching behavior across different supervisors.' Inter-rater reliability in educational evaluation measures the level of agreement and consistency between different observers applying the same assessment instrument. High inter-rater reliability ensures that independent supervisors evaluating the same classroom session using a rubric assign similar scores, thereby reducing personal subjectivity, administrative bias, and measurement inconsistencies across evaluations.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। शैक्षणिक मूल्यांकन में इंटर-रेटेर विश्वसनीयता विभिन्न पर्यवेक्षकों के बीच सहमति और स्थिरता के स्तर को मापती है जो एक ही मूल्यांकन उपकरण का उपयोग कर रहे हैं। उच्च इंटर-रेटेर विश्वसनीयता यह सुनिश्चित करती है कि एक ही कक्षा सत्र का मूल्यांकन करने वाले स्वतंत्र पर्यवेक्षक एक ही रूपरेखा का उपयोग करते हुए समान स्कोर असाइन करें, जिससे व्यक्तिगत पक्षपात, प्रशासनिक पूर्वाग्रह और मूल्यांकन में असंगतियों को कम किया जा सके।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) The consistency with which the rubric measures the same teaching behavior across different supervisors

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding
       Fiedler’s Contingency Theory:
       I. It posits that a leader’s style is relatively
            fixed and difficult to change.
       II. Situational favorableness depends on leader-
            member relations, task structure, and
            position power.
       III. Task-oriented leaders perform best
            in situations of moderate control and
            favorableness.
       IV. The model suggests matching the leader’s
            style to the appropriate situation rather
            than changing the leader’s style.
       Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I, II, and III only
I, II, and IV only
II, III, and IV only
I, III, and IV only
questions.explanation_english:
Fiedler’s Contingency Model asserts that
     leadership effectiveness depends on matching a
     fixed leadership style to situational favorableness,
     determined by leader-member relations, task
     structure, and position power. Task-oriented
     leaders thrive in highly favorable or highly
     unfavorable situations, whereas relationship-
     oriented leaders excel in moderately favorable
     conditions requiring interpersonal collaboration.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। फीडलर का आकस्मिकता मॉडल यह बताता है कि नेतृत्व की प्रभावशीलता एक निश्चित नेतृत्व शैली को स्थिति की अनुकूलता के साथ मिलाने पर निर्भर करती है, जो नेता-कार्यकर्ता संबंधों, कार्य संरचना, और पद शक्ति द्वारा निर्धारित होती है। कार्य-उन्मुख नेता अत्यधिक अनुकूल या अत्यधिक प्रतिकूल स्थितियों में उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शन करते हैं, जबकि संबंध-उन्मुख नेता मध्यम अनुकूल स्थितियों में बेहतर प्रदर्शन करते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) I, II, and IV only

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Fiedler’s Contingency Model asserts that leadership effectiveness depends on matching a fixed leadership style to situational favorableness, determined by leader-member relations, task structure, and position power.

questions.question_english:
The concept of 'Job Enrichment' as a motivational strategy
     (derived from Herzberg’s theory) involves:
options_english: Substantially increasing the teacher’s regular monthly salary, performance allowances, and financial bonuses
Adding a greater volume of routine administrative clerical tasks to the teacher’s daily overall workload
Simply adding a greater number of same-level operational tasks without changing responsibility (horizontal loading)
Increasing the depth, responsibility, and autonomy of the teacher’s role (vertical loading)
questions.explanation_english: Job enrichment is a motivational strategy derived from Herzberg’s theory that involves vertical loading of a role. It expands a teacher’s position by granting higher autonomy, increased decision-making responsibility, complex task variety, and professional accountability. This intrinsic enhancement makes work more fulfilling, fostering personal growth and higher professional engagement. The other options either focus on financial incentives, additional clerical tasks, or horizontal task expansion, which do not align with the core principles of job enrichment.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। जॉब एन्क्रिचमेंट एक प्रेरक रणनीति है जो हर्ज़बर्ग के सिद्धांत से व्युत्पन्न है। यह भूमिका के ऊर्ध्वाधर लोडिंग को शामिल करता है। यह शिक्षक की स्थिति को बढ़ाता है, जिसमें उच्च स्वायत्तता, निर्णय लेने की जिम्मेदारी, जटिल कार्य विविधता और पेशेवर जवाबदेही शामिल होती है। यह आंतरिक सुधार कार्य को अधिक संतोषजनक बनाता है, व्यक्तिगत विकास और उच्च पेशेवर संलग्नता को बढ़ावा देता है। अन्य विकल्प या तो वित्तीय प्रोत्साहनों, अतिरिक्त क्लर्क कार्यों, या क्षैतिज कार्य विस्तार पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हैं, जो जॉब एन्क्रिचमेंट के मूल सिद्धांतों के साथ मेल नहीं खाते।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Increasing the depth, responsibility, and autonomy of the teacher’s role (vertical loading)
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Job enrichment is a motivational strategy derived from Herzberg’s theory that involves vertical loading of a role.

questions.question_english: The clinical supervision cycle fundamentally relies on:
